column3: Set the pace from the start - clear of rivals throughout - ran out an easy winner
Held up towards the back early - urged along and made progress from 2f out - angled right approaching final furlong - kept on to the line without reaching the winner
Held a forward position early - pressed for effort with 2f left and still in with a shout inside the final furlong - held on for third without further gain
Settled in the pack early - urged forward and made ground 2f out - in contention approaching the final furlong - held to fourth without finding more close home
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to find the speed to get involved - finished well held in 5th
Held up eagerly early - sat with the pace - pressed for effort 2f out with nothing forthcoming - lost touch inside final furlong - unable to find more late finishing 6th
Sat second early - driven up to challenge inside the final two furlongs - shared front spot turning in - went clear a furlong out - fully extended under late pressure - held on for the win

Went straight to front - driven and under pressure from close attention 2f out - overtaken turning into the straight - fought back inside the final furlong - kept up the effort to the line - denied by a whisker
Settled in 5th early - pushed along turning for home - up to 3rd inside the final furlong - kept on but couldn't get to the front two
Sat close to the pace - pushed along turning for home - held 4th inside the last furlong without finding more
Sat close to the pace - pushed along 2f out then eased back to 5th approaching the final furlong - unable to find more late on
Slow to break - settled at the rear - pushed along with 2f left before fading out of contention
Tracked the pace - hit the front approaching the last furlong - came under strong pressure - kept on to win
Settled among the pack early - moved through and angled left approaching the final furlong - flew home to go down by a whisker in 2nd
Sluggish start - settled towards back - moved left and made ground into the straight - looking a threat approaching the last furlong but denied in the closing stages
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - hit the front and set the pace - challenged approaching the final furlong and put in front - battled on to finish fourth
Sat close to the front group early - pressed for effort with a furlong remaining - lost ground close home to finish 5th
Settled towards the back - unable to make headway inside final 2f - eventually finished 6th beaten 6.5 lengths
Held up early after a checked start - stayed towards the back then asked for effort out wide over 2f out - unable to make headway and finished well held in 7th

Settled in the pack early - made progress into contention 3f out - hit the front approaching 2f out under pressure - matched stride for stride through the closing stages - held on to prevail at the line

Settled towards the back - pushed along and made progress after moving left around 3f out - closed on leader from inside the final furlong and fought on gamely through the last furlong - narrowly denied at the line
Took them along - pressed for the lead 2f out and lost it there - plugged on through the closing stages without finding more - third
Held up towards the back - driven into contention 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out - kept going inside final furlong to finish fourth
Sat close behind the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to close 1f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Pulled hard early - up with the front group before dropping back 5f out - driven along and faded from 3f out home
Slow into stride and left behind early - settled in fourth - pushed along and made progress from 2f out - stayed on well inside final furlong - driven out to prevail right on the line

Sat just behind the front pair - moved through to hit the front approaching 3f out - driven on to open a gap over 2f out - margin narrowed inside the final furlong - caught in the last strides to be denied by a short head
Settled in 3rd - pushed along 2f out and closed on the front-runner inside the final furlong - faded late to finish third
Slow to begin and left trailing early - settled at the rear - unable to threaten - finished fourth beaten 6.25 lengths
Went straight to front - pressed for effort and lost command inside final 3f - dropped away quickly and finished well behind
Settled in the pack early - moved smoothly into command around 2f out - pushed further ahead soon after and driven out in the final stages to score comfortably
Held up at back - urged into contention 8th with 2f left - moved into second inside final furlong but couldn't threaten leader - stayed on to the line
Held a midfield spot early - urged forward into 7th with 2f left before nudged for effort - improved to 3rd inside final furlong but couldn't close on leader - stayed on at an even gait to finish 3rd
Held a midfield spot early - still only 13th under pressure 2f out - improved to 7th a furlong out and stayed on late for 4th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in 6th two furlongs out - unable to close in the final stages - finished fifth
sat close to the pace early - into 5th and pressed for effort 2f out - unable to close the gap late - finished 6th beaten 18½ lengths
Sat close up in 2nd early - shared the front from halfway - lost command 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out but slipped to 5th inside final furlong - unable to threaten again finishing 7th
Towards the back of the pack - made up ground into 11th before a minor bump 2f out - unable to land a blow in the closing furlong
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 3f out - well held throughout - finished 9th
front and clear early - matched by rival after 6f - regained advantage and driven out 3f out - given a squeeze but overtaken 2f out then dropped away steadily to finish tenth
Held up in the pack - pushed along in modest 14th two furlongs out - unable to close the gap - well held at the finish
towards the back early - pushed along and made up ground into 10th approaching 2f out - unable to threaten - well held in 12th
up with the front group early - pressed for effort 2f out - faded late to finish 13th
Poor getaway - stayed off the pace throughout - no impact on the finish - well held in 14th
up with the front group early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - dropped away steadily to finish last of the runners
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along and slipped back to 9th 2f out - faded late to finish well beaten
Settled around midfield - pressed for effort with 5f left before fading quickly - eased and pulled up 2f out
Sluggish start - settled midpack before improving into 4th when driven on after catching heels behind - stumbled and lost rider 2f out
Set the pace from the outset - roused along with two furlongs remaining - nudged along and squeezed under pressure inside the final furlong - responded gamely to assert close home
Settled just behind the pace - urged forward with two furlongs left - moved into second a furlong out - closed on the leader but edged out at the finish
Settled off the pace early - made ground into contention 5f out and driven wide approaching final 2f - held third but unable to find more inside the last
Sat behind leader - driven approaching 2f out - dropped to fourth and gave ground in the closing stages
Midpack early - found space and gained momentum 2f out before angling left inside final furlong - responded strongly through the last furlong - challenged inside last 110yds - hung on for victory

Handy in the pack early - travelling smoothly but boxed in around 2f out - eased left for space and hit the front inside the last furlong - driven up between opponents and stayed on strongly under 110yds out - denied by the narrowest of margins
Went straight to front - pressed for effort 2f out - overtaken inside final furlong - held steady tempo but couldn't quicken close home
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - urged forward with 3f left - driven approaching the final furlong - kept on late without threatening the front
Settled in a handy spot early - urged forward 3f out - driven approaching 2f out - still holding claims a furlong out - lost ground final furlong to finish 5th
Sluggish start leaving to settle near the back - pushed along with 3f remaining - unable to gain any headway - beaten off through to the line
Settled in the pack - improved into contention 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out but found little - slipped to the rear approaching the final furlong - faded away close home to finish seventh
Settled with eagerness close to the pace - pushed along with two furlongs left - moved through to hit the front a furlong out - stayed on strongly to win
Settled with plenty of energy near the back - urged forward approaching 2f out - found space to improve inside the final furlong and moved left to challenge up front - denied narrowly at the line
Set the pace early - pushed along approaching final two furlongs and lost the advantage inside the last - kept battling on to finish third
Sat close up in second early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - lost ground inside final furlong to finish 4th
Held up at the rear - pressed for effort over 2f out - unable to close - finished 5th beaten 8.25L
Settled midfield early - urged forward with three furlongs left - up in fourth with two to run - surged clear inside the final furlong to score
Sat handy on the rail behind the pace - pushed along into 3rd approaching final 2f - closed to 2nd inside the last and stayed on to finish a short head second
Settled through the pack early - up into 6th with 2f left - pushed along and gained ground to loom up second - hit the front approaching the final furlong - overtaken and held for third at the line
Slow to break - settled midfield on rail - urged into 9th 2f out - shaken up and improved to 6th before finishing 4th
Sluggish start and settled at the back - urged forward with 2f remaining - trailing wide turning into the straight - finished off well under encouragement - couldn't quite close in fifth
Settled in the middle of the pack - pushed along in 8th two furlongs out and still there a furlong later - finished with some late effort to end up sixth beaten 3¾ lengths
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - trailing the field turning into the straight - stayed on late to finish 7th beaten 4¼
Held up towards the back - pushed along in 10th with 2f remaining - unable to threaten leading pair - finished well held in 8th
Sat close behind the pace in 2nd - pushed along 2f out then slipped to 4th inside the final furlong - faded late to finish 9th
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 2f out - stayed on same gear to finish 10th
Set the pace early - opened up a gap approaching 2f out - pressed for effort entering the straight - overtaken inside the final furlong and faded to finish 11th
Settled around midfield - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - unable to land a challenge - finished well held in 12th
Settled in the pack - pushed along in 7th with two furlongs left - dropped away late to finish 13th
settled towards the back of the pack - pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped away to finish 14th
Sluggish start - held up at the back of the field - no impression made on the race - well held in 15th
Held up towards the back of the pack - unable to make headway from 3f out - well held at the finish
Sat close up early fighting for control - pushed along in 5th two out - faded late to finish 17th
Sat close to the pace fighting for control early - pushed along 3f out - dropped away to finish 18th well beaten
Settled at the back early - moved left and made progress 2f out before shifting left again a furlong out - hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Sat close to the pace - pressed forward 2f out and still in with a shout inside the final furlong - unable to get on terms with winner late
Sat close up early - hit the front over 2f out - pushed along a furlong later before giving way inside final furlong - unable to quicken late to finish third
Handy early on a tight hold - boxed in approaching 2f out - eased right to find room - stayed on through the last furlong without threatening the front - finished fourth beaten 4 lengths
Settled just behind the leading group - lost position and looked awkward with a furlong to go - dropped away close home to finish fifth
Held up towards the back of the field throughout - never a factor - well held in 6th
Handy early - hit the front turning into final 2f before being overtaken shortly after - dropped away inside final furlong to finish seventh
Sent clear in front early - overtaken with just over 2f to run - dropped away soon after - well held at the finish
Fretting in stalls and sluggish leaving gate - held up at rear - dropped a big distance behind final 5f - finished ninth

Tracked the front runner early - urged forward approaching final 2f - hit the front inside last furlong under pressure - had to fend off a rival close home - stayed on strongly in the closing stages to prevail
Settled in fourth early - improved into contention 2f out - guided across to the right approaching final furlong - pressed leader inside last - narrowly denied in second
settled at back of the field - made progress but boxed in for room 2f out - eased across left under pressure over 1f out and kept on to finish third by three quarters of a length
Set the pace early - driven approaching 2f out - lost the advantage inside final furlong - dropped away quickly - held no more in the closing stages
Settled handy early - urged forward with two furlongs left - driven approaching final furlong - unable to quicken through closing stages - faded to finish last of the group
Settled towards the back - nudged when the pace told over 3f out - pushed into contention from 1f out - surged to the front and drew away inside the final furlong to win with authority

Settled in the middle of the field - roused approaching the final furlong and pushed to the fore - drifted about once hitting the top - collared and kept on at one speed - runner-up beaten two and a quarter lengths
Set the tone from the off - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - lost the advantage and lost momentum inside the final furlong - kept going at a steady clip to finish third
Settled mid-pack early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - held on without gaining inside final furlong - finished 4th
Settled just behind the leader - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Held up at the back from the start - never featured in the finish - well beaten in 6th
Sat handy behind the front group - 4th with 2f remaining - asked for effort - edged in front 1f out - driven inside the final furlong as a rival came alongside - rallied to win at the post
sat behind the pace - pushed along to hit the front entering the straight - just overtaken a furlong out - locked together to the line and edged out by a nose
Sat handy behind front group - pressed for effort 3f out - down in 5th 2f out - improved into 3rd inside final furlong and stayed on to the line
Shared front-running spot early - hit the front under pressure into the last 2 1/2f before giving way turning in - settled in 4th with a furlong left - held that spot to the line without finding more
Settled midfield - pressed for effort 2f out and 7th approaching final furlong - stayed on late but never a serious factor
Sluggish start - settled towards the back and 12th with driving needed 2f out - modest late progress in the final furlong - finished sixth well beaten
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and up to 6th approaching 2f out - unable to threaten leaders - finished well held in 7th
Settled midpack in the early stages - pushed along around 8th approaching the final two furlongs - unable to close the gap - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - unable to make headway from 3f out - stayed on same speed to the line but well held throughout
Held up towards the back - pushed along and made up ground into 10th 2f out - unable to threaten leading pair - well held at the finish
sluggish start - settled in the pack - unable to threaten from 3f out and well held at the finish
Sluggish start - held up towards the back - made no impression - finished well beaten in 12th
Sluggish to break - stayed at the back of the field throughout - no impact on proceedings - finished well held in 13th
Shared front spot early - pushed along and lost command with 2 1/2f left - dropped away late to finish 14th
Held up rear of field throughout - no impression on leaders - finished well held in 15th
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along and slipped back to 9th with 2f left - faded out of contention late
Handy early - moved left and pressed forward with a furlong left - hit front inside final furlong - driven out to the line
Tracked the pace - moved right approaching final 2f - drifted left inside the last - stayed on into second close home
Pulled hard in front - soon clear of rivals - pressure applied entering final furlong - passed and dropped to third near line
Handy behind the pace - moved left approaching final 2f - found little in the closing stages - finished fourth beaten 1.25 lengths
Held up handy early - driven approaching final 2f - unable to find more inside the final furlong - finished 5th beaten 2¾ lengths
Settled in midfield early - crept closer inside final furlong - unable to threaten leading pair - finished sixth
Hesitant leaving stalls - settled at the back - toiling from 2f out and unable to threaten - finished seventh
Held up towards the back throughout - never troubled the leaders - well held in 8th
Held up at the back of the field - lost touch with 2f to go - beaten a distance in 9th
Towards the back of the pack - already out of contention over 2f out and finished tenth

Tardy start and dropped out lengths behind the field - last early - closed up 3f out - hampered 2f out and angled left in search of a gap - stayed on strongly inside the final furlong - hit the front with 110yds to run - won comfortably

Took strong hold early - travelled close to the pace - boxed in approaching 2f out - eased left and pushed along inside final 2f - hit front briefly inside the last furlong before being overhauled 110yds out - couldn't find more close home
Sluggish to find feet and settled towards the back - driven up into contention 3f out - hit front 2f out - overtaken inside final furlong - unable to find more close home - finished third
Sat close to the pace early - hit front 3f out then overtaken 2f out - lost touch inside final furlong to finish 4th
Settled in the pack - pushed along to make ground 3f out - lost placing 2f out - stayed on late for 5th
Took a strong hold early - hit the front before being overtaken 3f out - soon in trouble - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 6th
mid-pack early - pressed for effort with 3f left - couldn't find enough speed to get involved - well held at the finish
Settled towards the back - pushed along a furlong out - found a gap to draw alongside the pacesetter approaching the final furlong - drifted right - rallied gamely to get up on the line
Settled close to the front - shared command and pushed along over 2f out - moved to the front inside the final furlong - stayed on gamely to the line - edged out by a whisker - second
Held up at the back - lost touch with rivals 3f out - urged along with 2f left - kept going final furlong - flew home close home but couldn't get to winner
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along and made ground under 2f out - drifted left and kept battling inside the final furlong but never able to challenge
Set the pace early - lost the advantage and pushed along with over 2f left - kept battling near the rail in the closing stages but held for 5th
Settled mid-pack early holding a strong grip - unable to land a blow on the front end - finished 6th beaten 2.25 lengths
Handy early - shared front running before being pressed for effort over 2f out - dropped away close home - finished 7th beaten 2 1/2 lengths
mid-pack early - pushed along with 2f left - gave way inside the closing furlong to finish 8th
Sluggish start - eager and settled towards the back - knocked about inside final furlong then faded

Settled in the pack on the rail - squeezed for space approaching 2f out - driven up entering the straight and into 4th with a furlong left - hit the front inside the final furlong - kept finding more to the line
Sat close to the pace early - still 5th under pressure with 2f left - improved into 2nd inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish second beaten 1¾ lengths
settled midpack - moved into 4th 2f out under a push - up to 3rd 1f out - held effort to the line finishing 3rd

Sat second early - shared front running position with two and a half out - pressed for advantage entering straight - went in front a furlong out before being passed inside the last - unable to find more and held on for 4th
Settled in the middle of the pack - pulled hard early - nudged along in 7th 2f out and plugged on but never looked like troubling the principals
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - improved into 12th 2f out under pressure - progress to 7th inside final furlong - stayed on at one effort to finish sixth
Sat close to the front group early - into 6th under pressure with 2f left - unable to close late - finished 7th
Set the pace early - under pressure and drawn level 2f out - lost the advantage inside final furlong - dropped away to finish eighth
Held up towards the back on the inner - lost touch and boxed in 2f out - pushed along and stayed on late but never a factor - finished 9th beaten 5.75L
Sat close to the pace fighting for control early - pushed along in 3rd with 2f left - faded in the closing furlong to finish 10th
Held up towards the back - pushed along in 13th with 2f left - unable to make headway - finished well held in 11th
Settled in the pack - pushed along over 2f out - dropped away late - finished 12th beaten 8.5 lengths
Held up in the pack - pushed along in 15th with 2f left - unable to close - finished well held in 13th
Held up towards the back - pushed along in 11th two furlongs out - unable to close the gap - finished well held in 14th
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along in 14th with 2f left - unable to close - well held at the finish
Held up towards rear from the start - no real impression made through the race - well held at the finish
Held towards the centre of the pack wide of rivals - pushed along with 2f remaining - dropped away to finish 17th
Held up in rear from the start - no impression made - well beaten in 18th

Up with the front group - needed a couple of reminders at 6f out and again 4f out - moved to second and drifted left over 2f out - hit the front over 1f out - drew right away inside the final furlong to win
Set the pace early - come under pressure and pegged back approaching 2f out then overtaken with a furlong left - unable to threaten the winner through the closing stages
Slow to break - held up towards the back - improved into third approaching 2f out but unable to land a blow on the leading two
Tracked front-runner until over 3f out - dropped away over 2f out - finished 4th
Set the pace from the off - clear in front throughout - saw off rivals with ease
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and made progress 3f out - drifted right approaching final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish second
Handy in the early stages - pressed for effort 3f out - held the gallop through the closing stages to finish 3rd
Poor break then made up ground to sit behind pace - pushed along 3f out - unable to close 2f out - lost place late to finish 4th
Sluggish start - settled at back and pushed along with over 3f left - unable to match leaders for pace throughout

Took a strong hold early - sat handy with the pace - urged along approaching 2f out - moved to the front inside the final furlong - drifted left and stayed on through the last 110yds - margin narrowed near the line but held on to win
Hampered and hesitant to begin - settled towards the back of the field - urged forward with 2f left - flew home late gaining ground fast - claimed runner-up spot but couldn't get to the winner
Pulled hard in the leading group - pushed along 2f out - powered on inside the final furlong but wandered noticeably left - third at the line
Set the tempo from the start - roused along with over 2f to run before losing the advantage inside the final furlong - stayed on at an unchanged tempo to finish fourth
Held up at rear - unable to make an impression - finished well beaten in 5th
Broke left - took a strong hold - up in second - driven 2f out - badly hampered when challenging for the lead inside the final furlong and had to swerve - faded to finish sixth
Sluggish start - pulled hard while settling near the back - never troubled leaders - eventually home seventh
Settled just behind pace on inside - moved through to hit front approaching 2 out - opened up after final fence and kept on strongly to the line
Settled towards the back of the pack - made progress 3 out - up to 6th 2 out - pushed along in 3rd after the last - up into 2nd inside the final furlong - stayed on to the line

Set the pace early - shared the front around the 6th - pressed and lost the advantage before 2 out - second turning into the straight - third with a furlong left and unable to find more - finished 3rd beaten 7 lengths
Settled midpack early - pushed along in 10th two out before improving to 5th inside the final furlong - stayed on steadily to finish fourth
Settled midpack early - improved into 7th with two furlongs left then 4th turning for home - held that spot without finding more late on
Held up at the back - made progress 4 out - pushed along in 9th 2 out and stayed on same speed to finish 6th

towards back of field - jumped poorly at the 3rd and the rider momentarily dropped a stirrup - minor error at the 5th - nudged along to make ground before 2 out then plugged on at one speed through the straight to finish 7th

Bumped at the opening obstacle and jockey's foot came free of the stirrup - settled towards the back through the early stages and still in 11th approaching two out - stayed on at the same speed through the closing stages to finish eighth
Settled midfield - lost ground with minor error 3 out - moved strongly into second before 2 out then pressed for effort - slipped back to 5th turning into straight - faded to finish 9th
Sat close to the front pace under pressure from the rider - hit the front 4 out - lost the advantage soon after - faded from 2 out to finish 10th
Held a midpack spot early - under pressure in 12th two out - unable to make ground thereafter - well held in 12th
Sat close to the pace early - shared front spot by the 9th before losing command approaching 2 out - faded late finishing well beaten

Up with the front group early - sharing the front running by the 6th - near ejected at the 9th but rider stayed aboard in extraordinary fashion - dropped back through the field before fading out of contention
settled towards the back of the pack early - blundered at the opening fence and rider came off
Held up in the pack - lost touch from the 9th - eased out of contention and pulled up before two out
Held a midfield position early - error at the 3rd and another at the 6th sent it toward the back - minor stumble 8th before being pulled up
Held up at the rear throughout - hesitant at the opening obstacle and unable to make headway from 4 out - detached at the back before falling 2 out
Settled in the pack - hit the fence and pressed for effort three out - dropped away and pulled up before two out
held up towards the back - improved into 8th out wide 2 out - driven into 7th when blundered and lost rider at the last
Settled handy early - closed on pacesetter 3f out - driven to the front 2f out - drifted left approaching final furlong - kept going strongly to the line
Pulled hard early - up with the front group - angled left and driven 2f out - carried left before pressing the winner over 1f out - stuck on at one speed to finish second beaten 3 lengths
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left before improving into contention entering the last furlong - held rate to the line finishing third
Sluggish start - settled towards back - pushed along and made progress 2f out - contesting third turning into final furlong - unable to find more inside final 110yds and finished 4th

Slow into stride and settled last - fought for control early - moved to the left and pushed along 2f out - found extra gears but drifted left entering the final furlong - stayed on at one tempo to finish fifth
Set the pace early - driven along and challenged 3f out before losing the advantage 2f out - dropped away over 1f out to finish sixth
Pulled hard early - ventured out alone on the far flank for a spell - up with the front group after 1f - pushed along 2f out - faded to finish 7th
Slightly hesitant start - settled just behind the pace - made progress moving left approaching 2f out - hit the front inside final furlong and drifted left - stayed on strongly to score
Settled towards the back of the pack - asked for effort with 2f left - progress into second with a furlong to go - unable to challenge the winner - stayed on to finish second
Drifted right at the outset - settled towards the back - found space and moved right for room a furlong out - finished into third
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost the advantage inside the final two furlongs - couldn't find more approaching the line - finished fourth beaten 4 lengths
Settled towards the back early - moved through from a furlong out then drifted left approaching the final furlong - unable to threaten leaders and finished fifth
Held handy early - driven when knocked off stride 2f out - lost ground in closing stages - finished sixth
Up with the pace - dropped away 2f out - beaten comfortably from a furlong out

Held a handy position early - eased forward without fuss to hit the front 3f out - given a squeeze 2f out - pushed along a furlong out - kicked away inside the final furlong - won with something in hand
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and made progress 3f from home - stayed on inside the final furlong but unable to land a blow on the winner
Settled at the back - pushed along and made progress inside the last three furlongs - finished on one level note late to take third
Settled in the pack - urged forward but boxed in 3f out then eased left for room - stayed on at one gear inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Held up at the back - pushed along over 3f out and made ground into 2f out - stayed on inside final furlong to finish fifth
Sat close to the front - hit the front over 3f out but soon overhauled - faded from that point - lost more ground inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Tracked the pace from the wide side - pressed for effort with 3f left - drifted right approaching 2f out then moved left inside the final furlong - unable to find more and finished well held
Tardy start - moved up to front after 2f - pressed and lost top spot over 3f out - dropped right out from 2f out to finish eighth
dwelt at the start - pushed along from 3f out - never competitive and finished a remote 9th
Settled midfield - angled left and made progress inside the final furlong - stayed on to hit the front in the closing strides
Close up early - moved in front over 2f out - pushed along a furlong out then drifted right inside final 110yds - overtaken close home to finish second beaten a length
Sat close behind pace - pushed along with 1f left - couldn't quicken and edged out third
Held a spot in the pack early - moved up and shifted left approaching the final furlong - kept on at one speed to finish 4th
Held up handy in the pack - pushed along to bid over a furlong out - unable to find more in the closing stages - finished fifth
Jostled and pushed left at the break - settled towards the back - pressed for effort inside final furlong but unable to close - finished 6th
mid-pack early - pushed along a furlong out - weakened close home - finished 7th
Handy with the front group early - hampered for space 2f out and driven to respond - faded soon after - finished eighth beaten 8.75 lengths
Settled in the pack - shaping to improve but squeezed for space with a furlong left - lost ground close home - finished ninth
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost front spot inside final 2f - dropped away in the last furlong to finish 10th
Held a forward position early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 11th
Held up at the back throughout - never involved - finished well beaten in 12th
Drifted left out of the gates - stayed at the back throughout - well beaten a furlong out - finished last of the field

Settled second early - moved to front after 4 furlongs and opened a healthy advantage - margin narrowed with 3f to travel - challenger closed in - roused approaching final furlong - battled on well close home - overtaken inside final 110 yards - fought back close to the line to edge in front at the finish

Settled third early - improved to challenge outsider approaching 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong - edged in front close home but caught in the last strides - beaten a whisker for the win

Took a strong hold early - hit the front before being overtaken after 4f but stayed close in second - urged on 2f out and lost touch with the leaders - found renewed energy inside the final furlong to close the gap - finished third never a threat to the winner
Settled at the rear - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost touch and dropped away inside the final furlong
Sat just behind the front group in 3rd - error at the 8th - moved through to challenge for top spot 2 out - asked for effort and hit the front 1f out - pushed on strongly to the line for a clear win
Sat second early - hit front approaching 9th - drew level 2f out - pushed along into straight - overtaken with a furlong left - held on for second
